'''Zipline Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A large zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within a 110-meter radius to create a zipline.|Recently, ziplines became a growing fad in the tourism sector as well as extreme sports athletes. The Endfield marketing team really demonstrated their skills in this case.}}
==Usage==
A large zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within a 110-meter radius to create a zipline.
